689:t_007:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「$n, head to the point at ten o'clock!」

689:t_008:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$ソーラリアン$$ will hold position here!」

689:t_008:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「We have five minutes to do this! This ship can't last any longer!」

689:t_008:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ランド$$!」

689:t_008:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sorry, but I'm counting on you to clear out anything in our way!」

689:t_008:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This is a plan the Chief put her heart into! Just watch the results... as they say!」

689:t_009:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You must perform the ceremony for joining $c!」

689:t_009:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Is this any time to be fooling around!?」

689:t_009:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Precisely because it's a time like this!」

689:t_009:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here we go! You two companions are ready too, right?」

689:t_010:0.en:
$$真徒$$
「I don't know what you're planning, but it will all end in futility.」

689:t_010:1.en:
$$真徒$$
「After all, you're inferior species kept alive only by the Exalted Ones' mercy.」

689:t_010:2.en:
$$真徒$$
「Pray for salvation in your despair!」

689:t_010:3.en:
$$真徒$$
「And chant the word of salvation! Salus!!」

689:t_010:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「You sure talk a lot! Didn't you say you had no desire to talk to us!?」

689:t_010:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We've overcome threats like that time and again!」

689:t_010:7.en:
$n
「Right now, we just have to trust the Doctor and do it! With everything we've got!」

689:t_011:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The enemy's chain of command is in disarray!」

689:t_011:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「This is our chance, everyone!」

689:t_012:0.en:
$$真徒$$
「Don't think you can stop the $$ゼル・ビレニウム$$ with this much damage!」

689:t_013:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Ignore it! We have to do this first!」

689:t_014:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Good! All units have reached their points!」

689:t_014:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Everything's ready...! Now we can form the field!」

689:t_015:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What exactly are you planning, Chief!?」

689:t_015:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「What we're about to do is a kind of gamble.」

689:t_015:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「Normally, I should have prepared more, explained it properly to everyone, and made sure you understood its essence...」

689:t_015:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「But now that it's come to this, we've got no choice...!」

689:t_015:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Everyone... Does that mean it concerns us too, not just the Reactors!?」

689:t_015:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right. Now you're going to learn the true essence of $$次元力|lc$$.」

689:t_015:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「Even us, who don't have $$スフィア$$s!?」

689:t_015:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$スフィア$$s are merely engines for drawing out $$次元力|lc$$ efficiently.」

689:t_015:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「In principle, anyone should be able to draw out $$次元力|lc$$ in any environment.」

689:t_015:11.en:
$$シン$$
「I don't understand what you're getting at...」

689:t_015:13.en:
$$トライア$$
「The power of will draws out $$次元力|lc$$...! And everything possesses that will!」

689:t_015:14.en:
$$トライア$$
「Living beings aren't the only ones! Matter, the universe, and atoms have it too!」

689:t_015:16.en:
$$トライア$$
「Hydrogen and oxygen combine to form water...! That's the will of each element!」

689:t_015:17.en:
$$トライア$$
「The universe's will gives birth to $$バアル$$, and stars shine through their own will!」

689:t_015:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「Even if you suddenly tell us all that...!」

689:t_015:19.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We don't have time for fairy tales, Doctor!」

689:t_015:20.en:
$$トライア$$
「You should be able to understand!」

689:t_015:21.en:
$$トライア$$
「You've always believed in your machines and fought together with them, haven't you!?」

689:t_015:22.en:
$$トライア$$
「The times your machines moved in answer to your call despite damage that should have left them immobilized...」

689:t_015:23.en:
$$トライア$$
「The times attacks you poured your heart into broke through the enemy's barriers... Remember those moments!」

689:t_015:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「Can you still say your partners have no will... no heart!?」

689:t_015:27.en:
$$トライア$$
「And you're on the verge of grasping the truth!」

689:t_015:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「Understanding and accepting others... Advancing into the future together...」

689:t_015:30.en:
$$トライア$$
「Now, with the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ and $$スフィア$$s that gather human feelings, we'll release $$次元力|lc$$... matter's will, for just an instant!」

689:t_015:31.en:
$$トライア$$
「What happens next is up to you! Draw out the true power of yourselves and your partners!」

689:t_015:32.en:
$$真徒$$
「What are you planning to do!?」

689:t_015:33.en:
???
「I won't let you advance to that stage.」

689:t_016:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You are not permitted to advance to that stage.」
